faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper South condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper South sell for?
faq.a: 46 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper South between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $357,450.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: The median was 38 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper South sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 46 condos that sold in Chilliwack Proper South went for between $295,000 and $418,725, around a median of $357,450.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper South sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 46 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.2% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: Of the 46 sales, 46 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $363.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: The median year built was 2008 for the 46 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper South.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper South usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Chilliwack Proper South had 2 bedrooms, from the 46 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper South condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

46 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper South with a median price of $357,450 (the middle half sold between $295,000 and $418,725), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $398 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $363 a month. 26 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Proper South with a median price of $562,500 (the middle half sold between $525,000 and $610,000), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $343 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $381 a month.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper South compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median condo in Chilliwack Proper South sold for $357,450, 15% above the Chilliwack median of $310,000 across 133 sales. Chilliwack Proper South condos took a median 38 days to sell, against 36 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
